parameter.name: host
parameter.label: MQTT Broker Hostname / IP
parameter.description: Hostname or IP address of the MQTT broker (e.g. the machine running Zigbee2MQTT).

parameter.name: port
parameter.label: MQTT Broker Port
parameter.description: TCP port of the MQTT broker.

parameter.name: username
parameter.label: Username
parameter.description: MQTT broker username. Leave empty if the broker does not require authentication.

parameter.name: baseTopic
parameter.label: Base Topic
parameter.description: The base MQTT topic Zigbee2MQTT publishes to. Must match the Zigbee2MQTT configuration.

parameter.name: secure
parameter.label: TLS / SSL
parameter.description: Enable TLS encryption for the MQTT connection.

parameter.name: deviceName
parameter.label: Device Name
parameter.description: The device's friendly_name as configured in Zigbee2MQTT. This is also the MQTT topic suffix (e.g. "Living Room Light" → zigbee2mqtt/Living Room Light).
